title: What If You Never Felt Fear?
script: What if you never felt fear again? Not less scared. Not scared at all. Day one, at the aquarium, you press your face against the shark tank and smile. Day two, the biggest roller coaster in the park, and you yawn the whole way down. Your best friend Mia films you. You're not even holding on! Day three, a little boy chases his ball toward a busy road. Everyone freezes. You don't. You sprint between the cars and grab him just in time. But then things start going wrong. Day six, you walk up to a growling dog to say hi, and it bites you. Day seven, the ice on the lake cracks under your feet, and you keep walking. Here's why. Fear was never a weakness. It's your brakes. A tiny spot deep in your brain slams them on before you even think. That's why you jump back from a snake before you know it's a snake. A real woman with damage to that spot kept picking up snakes, with no fear at all. Day nine, your house is on fire. Your little brother Sam is at the upstairs window. The burning stairs will collapse any second, and the fire truck's ladder is still a minute away. Mia grabs your arm. If those stairs fall, they'll have to save you both! Ten seconds. Nine. Eight. His room fills with smoke. Seven. Six. The stairs crack. Five. Four. The burning stairs, or the ladder. Without fear, would you run?

hud.label: REAL SCIENCE
hud.text: She felt no fear of snakes.

hud.label: THE COST
hud.text: If you fall, two to save.
